Metadata.Title: Ghost of Yotei
Metadata.Name: Enable Cutscene Skip (by ANHAR)
Metadata.Author: ANHAR
Metadata.Note: Tested working by ANHAR with PPSA26344 v01.008.000. Enables existing cutscene skip permission checks while retaining cinematic-state, handle and authored-scene checks. Use the normal in-game skip control. No speed boost or custom hotkeys. Restart game after enabling. Some scenes may remain unskippable.
